The proof uses the actual pullback-pasting isomorphism and the full original open-immersion range, with the original p-first test pullback preserved. Both whole finite and whole infinity opens of the Contact curve therefore give a genuine full two-affine cover after ANY affine scheme test over Q, including nonreduced/non-Noetherian tests. The proved original-line acyclicity then makes the SAME derived Mayer-Vietoris boundary surjective and identifies actual original global H1 with actual overlap sections modulo the literal finite-minus-infinity restriction difference. Boundary computation on every quotient representative is retained. No separate acyclicity, finite-rank, reducedness or field premise is supplied.
